steps.label: Start
steps.note:
(BPOG/GPOB version of main box): https://ff14.toolboxgaming.space/?id=109976780281761&preview=1

Phase starts in O12S Arena, w/ Male starting West & Female starting East, IMMEDIATELY casting Firewall into Solar Ray

Groups pre-position East/West to obtain Firewall & begin the phase.

steps.label: Setup
steps.note:
Firewall resolves, giving everyone a debuff tying you to your Omega. Both Omegas immediately cast their Solar Ray tankbuster.

Get ready to lineup.

steps.label: Lineup
steps.note: Both bosses will now cast Party Synergy. Have everyone lineup conga to see where to adjust next.

steps.label: Party Synergy 1a
steps.note:
When Synergy resolves, all eight players will receive Playstation markers & a tether indicating Mid or Remote Glitch, a debuff that will give you a Vuln Up if you are too far *or* too close to your partner (Just too close for Remote). In addition, the Eye will spawn in a random cardinal or intercardinal, marking the next arena split, & M/F clones will spawn with weapons indicating the first aoe sequence.

To resolve, have the players split West/East-side looking at the Eye, w/ the Left-marker moving West, the Right-marker moving East.

steps.label: Party Synergy 1b
steps.note:
As you start resolving your tether groups, start adjusting for the appropriate pattern. There will always be a Male & Female pair across the arena from eachother, & depending on what weapon they draw will determine the dodge pattern.
 -Female
   ~Blade-Legs - Sides cleaved(Mid-safe)
   ~Spear - Cross-AOE
 -Male
   ~Shield - Dynamo(In)
   ~Sword - Chariot(Out)

In this case, it's In(Shield)+Cross(Spear)

steps.label: Party Synergy 1c
steps.note:
Resolve first set (In/Cross in this case)

Stick to your group sides and be ready to split for the Eye.

steps.label: Party Synergy 2a
steps.note:
Groups split East/West OF THE EYE to prep for laser & spreads.

Male chariot clones will now start to spawn, showing 2 outer safe spots for later.

steps.label: Party Synergy 2b (Mid Glitch)
steps.note:
Finish setting up your spreads/split using an order of B-P-O-G (Blue,Yellow,Orange[Red],Purple), then stay on the edge of the markers like shown for Mid Glitch. (Using North->South lineup for both sides [Eye is North])

If your markers are placed on the *3rd* Outer Ring, the outer edge of the marker will be the exact mid-tether distance, & the inner edge will be the exact eye-cleave width.

SHIELDS AND MIT ARE VERY HELPFUL HERE FOR THE SPREAD HIT

steps.label: Party Synergy 2b (Remote Glitch)
steps.note: Remote Glitch spread spots, following BPOG/GPOB (Middle 2 never flexing)

steps.label: Party Synergy 2c (Mid Glitch)
steps.note:
Let spreads/eye-cleave resolve. (Always check if you have Vuln to determine safe distance)

Female will start to spawn in mid, readying the last segment.

steps.label: Party Synergy 2c (Remote Glitch)
steps.note: Remote Glitch spot resolution

steps.label: Party Synergy 3a
steps.note:
The eye will disappear, Female will spawn in middle, & 2 stack-markers will go out. Each group will need to be knocked back into the remaining safe-spots from the coming Male-chariots. 

Treating the 3-males as North, be knocked corresponding to your group & debuff. For Remote, use East/West like the lineup. For Mid, have the East group be knocked "South".

If there's more than one stack on a side, have the *North*-most stack from the lineup & their partner flex.

steps.label: Party Synergy 3b (Remote Glitch)
steps.note: Get knocked back into your safe-spots as you take your stacks, resolving the Glitch tethers/clones. (Remote solution w/ East/West knockbacks [3males North])

steps.label: Party Synergy 3b (Mid Glitch)
steps.note: Get knocked back into your safe-spots as you take your stacks, resolving the Glitch tethers/clones. (Mid solution w/ East group being knocked "South")

steps.label: Cast
steps.note:
Come back to mid to prepare for Limitless Synergy. Double -check you're hitting your correct Omega.

Male will cast Synthetic Shield, followed by both casting Limitless Synergy.

steps.label: Limitless Synergy 1a
steps.note:
Male & Female will shift to the North of the arena, with Female beginning a long "Laser Shower" cast, & Male using his shield. Firewall will drop, & most of the party will now have to stack center and begin pummeling M to beat the DPS check.

In addition, 5 clones will spawn around the arena. Two with tank tethers, one(M) casting Arrow through an intercardinal, & two starting the casts for round2.

The Arrow will bait at the *start* of the cast like a standard LB, so the party should be stacking max-melee at an intercard (3 in this case) before heading out to handle tethers.

steps.label: Limitless Synergy 1b
steps.note: Wait for the arrow cast to appear before heading in. The tanks take their tethers and face the clones away CW/CCW from the group like so.

steps.label: Limitless Synergy 1c
steps.note:
If all is done correctly, you should be able to step into Males hitbox from the arrow cast.

The remaining Male clone will cast shield. Use this position as reference for Beyond Defense.

steps.label: Limitless Synergy 2a
steps.note:
Heal/shield up & use a lot of mit (~5 10%'s/~40%real-mit), as the remaining outside F-Clone casts Meteor on 3 players. In order to help conserve resources for the next two phases' dps checks, we'll be stacking & mitigating all metors in center.

To bait the beyond defense away from the group, have both tanks loosely spread in the direction of the Shield clone outside, but dont stray too far, as he'll target the 1st or 2nd closest player.

steps.label: Limitless Synergy 2b
steps.note: Right before meteors resolve, Beyond Defense will go off.

steps.label: Limitless Synergy 2c
steps.note:
Meteors go off & shortly after Male sends Pile Pitch to the closest players (The party stack in this case), with the Beyond Defense tank moving out.

Keep some mitigation saved for Cosmo Memory next, but otherwise burn down the boss & start saving resources for P3.

steps.label: Cosmo Memory
steps.note:
All that remains is a Cosmo Memory raidwide cast, with a DPS check on Omega-M, then Omega-F when the shield is down.

Make sure to position behind Male/the shield so you can immediately target Female.

steps.label: Enrage
steps.note:
When Omega-M is downed, kill Omega-F before Laser Shower, the Phase Enrage at approx. ~2:27.

You did it! On to P3: https://ff14.toolboxgaming.space/?id=243183080764761&preview=1
